# Fixtures

Public fixtures use neutral coordinates (0, 0). Throwaway capture credentials
and mock API tokens are generated at runtime and never included in fixtures.

* `core/` — captured from a real, throwaway Home Assistant Core 2026.10.1 with
  `devtools/capture_core_fixtures.py` (config entries incl. a real
  `setup_retry` entry, areas, entity registry, states with two unavailable
  entities, repairs, `/api/config`). The `ma_entries_*.json` and
  `flow_progress_ma_discovered.json` files are derived from the captured entry
  shape for the `music_assistant` domain (it needs a running Music Assistant
  server, so it can't be captured from a bare Core).
* `supervisor/` — Supervisor v1 wire format (`{"result": "ok", "data": …}`),
  generated by `devtools/make_supervisor_fixtures.py` with the exact field
  sets of supervisor 2026.10.1 (`api/root.py`, `api/apps.py`, `api/store.py`,
  `api/host.py`, `api/resolution.py`, `jobs/__init__.py`) and real error
  messages from `exceptions.py`.
* `music_assistant/` — Music Assistant server `GET /info`
  (`music_assistant_models.api.ServerInfoMessage`).

Review provenance: Supervisor and MA fixtures are synthesized, not live HAOS
captures. The review compared them with Supervisor `2026.10.1`, Core
`2026.10.1` and MA `2.10.6` source. The browser navigation harness follows the
message handler in frontend `20260930.3` (Core 2026.10.1's pinned dependency);
its destination page remains a stand-in, not the actual HA/MA UI.

The mock's `config/auth/list` users mirror Core's
`components/config/auth.py::_user_info` fields used for authorization
(`id`, `is_active`, `is_owner`, `system_generated`, `group_ids`). Users are
never returned by Home Starter's browser API. Tests explicitly reject unknown,
inactive, ordinary and system users, and fail closed when lookup is unavailable.
